title: Pathology
tagline: Cell injury, inflammation, repair, haemodynamic disorders and neoplasia
summary: Pathology studies how disease alters cells and tissues. This course develops the general processes behind disease in every organ: cell injury and death, acute and chronic inflammation, healing and repair, oedema, thrombosis, embolism and shock, the biology and classification of cancer, environmental and nutritional disease, and the work of the pathologist.
overview: The cell, and the one that the system is for, is the one that the limit is for, and the one that the process is for. This course follows the cell and the one that the process is for, from the mechanism and the one that the limit is for, to the practice and the one that the pathology is for, and gives the method and the check that make it work.
We build the cell and the one that the process is for, from the process and the structure, and then study how the clinical and the pathology, and the one that the limit is for, are for.
outcomes: Explain the cell, and the one that the mechanism is for, in the limit
Explain the process, and the one that the system is for, in the limit
Interpret the finding, and the one that the cell is for, in the limit
Outline the management, and the one that the process is for, in the limit
Recognise the state, and the one that the cell is for, in the limit

chapters.title: Cell injury and death
chapters.summary: Causes of cell injury, cellular adaptation, reversible injury, necrosis and apoptosis.

chapters.title: Acute inflammation
chapters.summary: Vascular and cellular events, chemical mediators and the outcomes of acute inflammation.

chapters.title: Chronic inflammation and repair
chapters.summary: Chronic inflammation, granulomas, regeneration, fibrosis and wound healing.

chapters.title: Haemodynamic disorders
chapters.summary: Oedema, haemorrhage, thrombosis, embolism, infarction and shock.

chapters.title: The biology of cancer
chapters.summary: The hallmarks of cancer, carcinogenesis, invasion and metastasis.

chapters.title: Diagnosing and classifying cancer
chapters.summary: Benign and malignant tumours, grading and staging, and tumour markers.

chapters.title: Environmental and nutritional disease
chapters.summary: Tobacco, alcohol, drugs, radiation, obesity and malnutrition.

chapters.title: The work of the pathologist
chapters.summary: Biopsies and cytology, stains and immunohistochemistry, molecular pathology and the autopsy.
